manifest.title: Split Optimizer (built on Fynd) vs three DEX aggregators: live quotes on the same block
manifest.method:
Fynd = what a Fynd deployment returns, the best by net output of its three
routers at 4 hops (water-fill, path Frank-Wolfe, split router), committed router 37aedc3 (later commits
leave routes unchanged); aggregators limited to the venue types Fynd covers (no RFQ / private market
makers), each aggregator's own fee added back where its quote deducted one. Gross = amount out
before gas. Net = amount out less the route's gas at the block's base fee, priced in the output
token. Comparisons whose gross difference is 1,000 bps or more either way are left out of the
aggregates, as are orders under $1,000 and orders the router found no route for; most are tokens
the router does not yet cover well, and every one is still in results.csv.
